messages:
lee: quick q — should deploy-bot auto-bump for lockfile-only changes?

maria: honestly i'd prefer no. we saw a transient when a lockfile bump pulled a newer minor.

sam: +1. conservative by default. docs-only or release-note-only OK to auto-patch. lockfiles should need human OK.

lee: current rule: if PR title has "chore(lockfile)" deploy-bot will create a patch tag. that's been noisy.

deploy-bot: detected PR #4247: files changed: [yarn.lock] -> action: created draft tag v1.12.5 (auto-patch) -> assigned canary.

maria: that auto patch triggered a canary which failed in canary region due to a transitive dep change. caused rollback last week.

tzach: proposal: tighten heuristics. Only auto-bump patch for PRs labeled "docs" or "release-note". lockfile-only -> require manual /release OK.

sam: also add a rule: if files touch runtime/ or runtime-deps/ treat as a minor bump candidate and require canary + 2 reviewer approvals.

lee: naming: some folks want to append buildmeta (+gitsha) to tags for CI clarity. I worry about semver semantics if we start pushing buildmeta into canonical tags.

maria: let's avoid buildmeta in release tags we serve to customers. Keep tags strictly semver (x.y.z). CI artifacts can be annotated in release body (build sha, image id).

sam: agreed. canonical tags = semver only. if we need machine-readable uniqueness, use release metadata, not tag suffixes.

lee: rollback heuristic discussion: current logic auto-rolls back to previous tag if canary error rate > 5% across regions. smaller regressions only hold canary and alert oncall. thoughts?

tzach: that threshold worked well, but we should make it configurable per-route. latency regressions might need different thresholds than error spikes.

maria: good point — make thresholds per service and surface in the console. Also document the manual-rollback playbook in release playbook.

lee: action items: 1) i'll open PR to change deploy-bot rules: no auto-patch for lockfile-only, only for docs/release-note; 2) add runtime/ -> minor-bump rule; 3) add per-route rollback thresholds and update playbook. @maria @sam please review the PR.

maria: will review tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

sam: same, will check the canary policy bits.

deploy-bot: info: dry-run of new heuristics scheduled at 03:00 UTC — will post results in #eng-releases once complete.
